.parentDirDiv {

.fileDiv {
    transform-origin: top center;
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    padding: 10px 15px;
    border: none;
    font-size: large;

}

.fileDiv:nth-of-type(odd) {

}

.fileDiv:first-of-type {

}

}

.fileDiv:first-of-type span[filter="m"] {
    cursor: pointer;
}

.fileDiv:not(:first-of-type) {
    animation: slide .3s ease 1;
}

.fileDiv:not(:first-of-type):hover {
    opacity: .7;
}

.fileDiv:not(:first-of-type) .fileSize {
    text-align: right;
    direction: ltr;
}

.fileDiv .downloadBtn {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;

.fileDiv .fa-folder {
    color: orange;
}

.input {

    border: none;

    max-width: 30%;

.paginationDiv {
    display: none;

    border-radius: 5px;
    font-size: small;
}

.paginationNav {
    background-color: #077ccc;
    color: #fff;
}

.paginationPages {
    display: inline-block;
}

.paginationBtn_disabled {
    background-color: #f6f6f6;
    color: #ededed;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.paginationBtn_selected {
    background-color: #077ccc;
    color: #fff;
}

.paginationBtn:hover {
    cursor: pointer;
    opacity: .6;
}

.paginationTxt {
    font-weight: bold;
}
